First check whether the manufacturer should handle the repair

Find the purchase invoice and check the manufacturer’s warranty terms for your model and fault. If a warranty may apply, contact the manufacturer before commissioning independent repair. Coverage, exclusions and the effect of outside work depend on the applicable terms; do not assume all faults or accidental damage are covered.

GR Solution is an independent TV repair provider. A brand name in a service description identifies the televisions discussed; it does not mean the business is that manufacturer’s authorised service centre.
Send the details that make a visit easier to plan

A short, precise description is more useful than “screen problem”. Describe what first failed and whether the TV still produces sound, shows a menu or responds to its remote. A brief video can help show an intermittent symptom, but it does not confirm the failed part.

Send your address and model-label photos through the private booking channel. Do not post personal details or serial numbers publicly.
Confirm arrangements before the technician travels

Request a visit rather than assuming an online enquiry reserves a time slot. Confirm availability for your locality, a suitable time window and how the technician will contact you. For a tower or gated community, explain entry rules, lift access and parking restrictions that affect carrying equipment or a large TV.
Explain whether the television is wall-mounted, on a stand or already removed. Do not attempt a heavy or awkward unmounting alone.
Ask whether unmounting, remounting, transport or workshop handling may be needed and whether any of these carry a separate charge.
Keep the remote and relevant connected device available so the original symptom can be demonstrated.
Clear a safe working area. If there is liquid damage, sparking or a burning smell, stop using the TV and explain this when requesting help.

GR Solution’s published diagnosis policy is free diagnosis with an estimate before paid repair work. Confirm the specific visit arrangements and any other applicable charges in advance. A symptom, locality or brand does not guarantee same-day repair or part availability.
Approve a clear estimate, not just a part name

Ask what the diagnosis established and whether anything remains uncertain. “Panel problem” or “board problem” is not a complete scope of work. The estimate should distinguish repair from replacement and explain the proposed part, labour, handling and any other charges before work starts.
Ask for the total payable and what would trigger a revised estimate. Additional paid work should need your approval.
If a replacement part is proposed, ask whether it is new, refurbished or used and how compatibility is checked.
Confirm whether work can be completed at home or whether workshop testing is required. For collection, request a written receipt identifying the TV, accessories and visible condition.

Request the repair-specific warranty or service terms in writing, including duration, exclusions and the process for reporting the same fault again. Do not assume a standard duration applies to every repair.

If a panel replacement is costly or parts are scarce, compare the complete quote with a suitable replacement TV. You can ask questions or decline a repair after reviewing the estimate; do not approve work simply because a visit has occurred.

Run these checks before accepting completion

Test the condition that originally caused trouble, rather than accepting a brief start-up screen as the only check. An intermittent issue may need longer observation; agree how an unresolved or recurring symptom will be handled. Only test inputs and features relevant to your TV and the approved repair.
External checks after an approved TV repair
Check
What to confirm
Original fault
Repeat the same source, app or use case that previously failed
Picture
Watch normal content and the TV menu for the reported lines, flicker or loss of picture
Sound
Confirm the intended speakers or sound system work at a comfortable volume
Inputs and remote
Check the connected devices and remote functions involved in the repair
Physical setup
Ask the technician to confirm safe stand or mounting arrangements and cable routing
Documentation
Keep the invoice, approved work description, part details and written repair terms

These checks help you confirm the agreed outcome; they cannot guarantee that an older television will never develop another fault. Keep a record of the repair date and report a recurrence promptly through the agreed contact channel.
Request a visit with the right expectations

GR Solution serves Delhi, Noida, Greater Noida and Ghaziabad. Share the city, model and symptoms to discuss availability and inspection-based next steps. A phone conversation can help plan a visit, but a final diagnosis and firm estimate depend on checking the TV. There is no need to guess the failed component before you contact the service provider.

What should I share when booking TV repair at home?
Share the full model, screen size, symptom, city or locality and whether the TV is wall-mounted. Confirm availability, access requirements and any handling arrangements before the visit.
Is GR Solution an authorised manufacturer service centre?
GR Solution is an independent TV repair provider. If manufacturer warranty may apply, check with the manufacturer before arranging independent work.
Does requesting free diagnosis confirm a visit?
No. The team must confirm locality coverage, availability and visit arrangements. GR Solution’s published policy provides free diagnosis and an estimate before paid repair work begins.
Will every TV repair be completed at my home?
No. The fault, safe access, equipment and part availability determine whether work can be completed at home or needs workshop handling. Confirm the proposed process and any charges before approval.
What should I check after a TV repair?

Reproduce the original fault conditions, check picture, sound and relevant inputs, and keep the invoice, work description and written repair terms. Agree how any unresolved or recurring symptom will be reported.
